english: 193-198. Ever since then, medicinal herbs and other vegetables are cultivated by means of ploughshares. The subjects sustained themselves by means of agricultural occupations and were protected by Kṣatriyas. The organization of castes and stages of life and the institution of Yajña characterize Tretā Yuga. The senseless subjects abandoned salvation in the form of meditation on Sadāśiva and resorted to flowery speech. Through attachment they attained heaven.
